xccdf-1.2:Profile.xccdf-1.2:title: CUI, tailored for the CHP server
xccdf-1.2:Profile.xccdf-1.2:description:
Extends xccdf_org.ssgproject.content_profile_cui with one documented deviation, on the CHP server only: the rule chronyd_client_only is unselected.
Owner decision 2026-11-20: the CHP server serves time to the site LAN only (chrony allow <site subnet>, bindaddress SERVER_IP, firewalld 123/udp from the site subnet); workstations sync from it and never from outside sources.
The server's chrony therefore does not keep the profile's client-only setting (port 0). Workstations keep the stock profile, where the rule stays selected and passes.
